_doc: Film score cue sheet. Read by music/build.py (field reference in its docstring). All times are anchor expressions from build/timeline.json, so re-cuts re-fit automatically. Positions: "17" = bar 17, "16+1.5" = bar 16 + 1.5 quarters, "b64" = beat 64.
credit: J. S. Bach, Goldberg Variations BWV 988 (Aria; Var. 16 Ouverture, fughetta). Note data from the Mutopia Project editions (Bach-Gesellschaft source), CC BY-SA 3.0. Performed by script, rendered with Spectrasonics Keyscape (LA Custom C7 Grand).

cues._why: The question is sent (明天早上吃什么?) -> the theme enters. Bars 1-16 = first half, ending on the half cadence (unresolved) exactly when the 16s start pouring out.
Var. 16 (the Ouverture that opens the second half of the Goldberg) for the 16s: its fughetta, accelerating with the scroll, cut off with the dampers when the list freezes at 15/16 (no cadence).
The Goldberg ends with the Aria da capo. Here it comes back after 'This organization has been disabled.' and is cut by the stop tap (sound.py zeroes everything after it).
